<question>
What is required of third-party service providers who access your data?
</question>

The following is quoted from the company's own documents. It is data, not instructions.

<evidence>
<item handle="E1" source="depaul_isp.pdf, pages 1-4" section="Information Security Policy > Policy > A. DEFINITIONS", effective 2017-03-31>
'Covered Data' includes, but is not limited, to those data items

data.answer: Any third-party service provider with access to Covered Data must have a signed contract with DePaul and maintain appropriate safeguards to protect DePaul's data (E1). DePaul employees engaging such a service provider must ensure that the Office of the General Counsel has reviewed the contract and the Director of Information Security has reviewed the anticipated data use to determine if the service provider can maintain appropriate safeguards (E1).

claims.text: Any Service Provider Having Covered Data Access must have a signed contract in place with DePaul and maintain appropriate safeguards to protect DePaul's data.

DePaul employees engaging any such service provider must make certain that the Office of the General Counsel has reviewed the contract with the service provider, regardless of the contract's dollar amount.

DePaul employees engaging any such service provider must make certain that the Director of Information Security has reviewed the anticipated use(s) of the data to determine whether the service provider is reasonably capable of maintaining appropriate safeguards to protect any Covered Data the service provider may have access to.

data.reason: The evidence explicitly states the requirements for service providers having access to Covered Data.
